english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may heal all damage from 1 of your Pokémon.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出并进行进化时，可使用1次。将自己1只宝可梦的HP，全部回复。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may choose 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and put 1 damage counter on each of them.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出放于备战区时，可使用1次。给对手的2只备战宝可梦身上，各放置1个伤害指示物。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may look at the top 3 cards of your deck and attach any number of Basic Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出并进行进化时，可使用1次。查看自己牌库上方3张卡牌，选择其中任意数量的基本能量，以任意方式附着于自己的宝可梦身上。将剩余的卡牌放回牌库并重洗牌库。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may look at the top 8 cards of your deck and attach any number of Basic Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出并进行进化时，可使用1次。查看自己牌库上方8张卡牌，选择其中任意数量的基本能量，以任意方式附着于自己的宝可梦身上。将剩余的卡牌放回牌库并重洗牌库。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put a Supporter card from your opponent's discard pile into their hand.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出并进行进化时，可使用1次。选择对手弃牌区中的1张支援者，放回对手的手牌。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Asleep.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出并进行进化时，可使用1次。令对手的战斗宝可梦陷入'''{{TCG|睡眠}}'''状态。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may move an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of their Benched Pokémon.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出并进行进化时，可使用1次。选择对手战斗宝可梦身上附着的1个能量，转附于对手的备战宝可梦身上。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 3 Flamigo, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出放于备战区时，可使用1次。选择自己牌库中最多3张「缠红鹤」，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并重洗牌库。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may choose 1: put a Supporter card from your discard pile into your hand; or search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, put it into your hand, and then shuffle your deck.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出并进行进化时，可使用1次。选择自己的牌库或弃牌区。选择其中1张支援者，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。如果查看过牌库的话，则重洗牌库。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出放于备战区时，可使用1次。选择对手战斗宝可梦身上附着的1个特殊能量，放于弃牌区。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may draw 3 cards.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出并进行进化时，可使用1次。从自己牌库上方抽取3张卡牌。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 3 Basic {{e|Fire}} Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出并进行进化时，可使用1次。选择自己牌库中最多3张「基本{{e|火}}能量」，以任意方式附着于自己的宝可梦身上。并重洗牌库。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may have your opponent reveal their hand, and then you choose 2 Energy cards you find there and shuffle them into your opponent's deck.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出并进行进化时，可使用1次。查看对手的手牌，选择其中2张能量，放回对手牌库并重洗牌库。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 3 {{TCG|Pokémon Tool card}}s, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出并进行进化时，可使用1次。选择自己牌库中最多3张「宝可梦道具」，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并重洗牌库。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may prevent all damage from and effects of attacks from your opponent's Pokémon done to this Pokémon until the end of your opponent's next turn.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出并进行进化时，可使用1次。在下一个对手的回合结束前，这只宝可梦，不受到对手宝可梦招式的伤害和效果影响。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may heal all damage from your Active {{e|Grass}} Pokémon. If you healed any damage in this way, discard all Energy from that Pokémon.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出并进行进化时，可使用1次。将自己战斗场上{{e|草}}宝可梦的HP，全部回复。然后，将回复了HP的宝可梦身上附着的能量，全部放于弃牌区。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may switch it with your Active Pokémon. If you do, you may move any amount of Energy from your other Pokémon to this Pokémon.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出放于备战区时，可使用1次。将这只宝可梦与战斗宝可梦互换。如果成功执行互换了的话，则选择任意数量的自己场上宝可梦身上附着的能量，转附于这只宝可梦身上。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may heal all damage from each of your Evolution Pokémon. If you healed any damage in this way, discard all Energy from those Pokémon.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出并进行进化时，可使用1次。将自己所有进化宝可梦的HP，全部回复。然后，将回复了HP的宝可梦身上附着的能量，全部放于弃牌区。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 3 Basic {{e|Fighting}} Energy cards and discard them. Then, shuffle your deck.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出放于备战区时，可使用1次。选择自己牌库中最多3张「基本{{e|斗}}能量」，放于弃牌区。并重洗牌库。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has 90 HP or less remaining to the Active Spot.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出并进行进化时，可使用1次。选择对手备战区中的1只剩余HP在「90」及以下的宝可梦，将其与战斗宝可梦互换。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may attach up to 2 Basic {{e|Fighting}} Energy cards from your hand to this Pokémon.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出放于备战区时，可使用1次。选择自己手牌中最多2张「基本{{e|斗}}能量」，附着于这只宝可梦身上。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard the top card of your opponent's deck.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出放于备战区时，可使用1次。将对手牌库上方1张卡牌放于弃牌区。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard a Stadium in play.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出放于备战区时，可使用1次。将场上的竞技场放于弃牌区。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may attach up to 2 Basic {{e|Metal}} Energy cards from your discard pile to your {{e|Metal}} Pokémon in any way you like.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出并进行进化时，可使用1次。选择自己弃牌区中最多2张「基本{{e|鋼}}能量」，以任意方式附着于自己的{{e|鋼}}宝可梦身上。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may attach up to 2 Spiky Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出并进行进化时，可以使用1次。选择自己弃牌区中最多2张「尖钉能量」，附着于这只宝可梦身上。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出并进行进化时，可以使用1次。给对手的1只宝可梦身上放置2个伤害指示物。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon and put 2 damage counters on each of them.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出并进行进化时，可以使用1次。给对手的2只宝可梦身上各放置2个伤害指示物。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 5 Basic {{e|Darkness}} Energy cards and attach them to your Marnie's Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出并进行进化时，可以使用1次。选择自己牌库中最多5张「基本{{e|恶}}能量」，以任意方式附着于自己的「玛俐的宝可梦」身上。并重洗牌库。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put up to 2 Arven's Sandwich cards from your discard pile into your hand.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出并进行进化时，可以使用1次。选择自己弃牌区中最多2张「派帕的三明治」，在给对手看过之后加入手牌。

english: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出并进行进化时，可以使用1次。选择对手的1只备战宝可梦，将其与战斗宝可梦互换。

english: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, if you have any {{DL|Pokémon ex (TCG)|Tera Pokémon ex|Tera Pokémon}} in play, you may search your deck for up to 2 {{TCG|Trainer card}}s, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
chinese: 在自己的回合，当将这张卡牌从手牌使出并进行进化时，如果自己场上有「太晶」宝可梦的话，则可以使用1次。选择自己牌库中最多2张训练家，在给对手看过之后。加入手牌。并重洗牌库。
